title: A Unified Kalman-Type Classification of Controllability for Linear Stochastic Systems
summary: Formalization of a finite algebraic classification of approximate, approximate null, exact null, and exact controllability for finite-dimensional linear stochastic systems with constant coefficients and independent Brownian drivers. A decreasing subspace sequence gives a common obstruction for the first three properties; exact controllability additionally requires full row rank of the stacked diffusion-control matrix.
